title: EvoRender: An Agentic AI-Neural Rendering Algorithm Discovery
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition

publication.venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition

mechanism.domainTask: LLM-guided discovery of neural texture compression decoder algorithms
mechanism.populationDetail: Four independent islands maintain decoder-program subpopulations for diversity; the initial decoder library includes 15 implementations.
mechanism.archiveDetail: Each island samples parents from its top 20% by score and retains a bounded population of high-fitness programs.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The method follows OpenEvolve's island-based population update; candidates must pass syntax and forward-pass checks before fitness comparison.
mechanism.generationDetail: One selected decoder program is mutated within its editable code block; activation, initialization, scaling, gating, skip connections, and forward arithmetic can change.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Composite fitness uses normalized PSNR, numerical stability, and a parameter-count penalty; score controls elite sampling and replacement.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: One parent is sampled from the top 20% by score within the selected island.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Search is constrained to neural texture decoder code with a fixed network interface, optimizing a quality/complexity trade-off.
